description: Switch the browser profile to another logged-in account (see account_info). Later calls act as it; reloads open Instagram tabs. Switching to the active account is a no-op.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

userId.description: Target account id from account_info. This or username required.

username.description: Target account username. This or userId required.

name: account_switch
title: Account switch
